source.title: Template:Data Dr. Mundo/Goes Where He Pleases

params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Dr. Mundo}} {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Passive:}} Periodically, '''Dr. Mundo''' gains immunity to the next hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect to affect him, and upon resisting one, he loses a portion of {{as|his '''current''' health}} and drops a canister nearby.
params.blurb3: '''Dr. Mundo''' and enemy {{tip|champions}} can move near the canister to destroy it. If he destroys the canister, the cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} and he will {{tip|heal}} for a portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|0.4; then +0.05*x for 5; then +0.1*x for 6; then +0.15*x for 3; then +0.2*x|formula=0.4% + 0.05% per level at level 1, then + 0.1% per level starting at level 7, then + 0.15% per level starting at level 13, then + 0.2% per level starting at level 16|key=%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{pp|0.4/10 to 0.65/10 for 6;0.75/10 to 1.25/10 for 6;1.4/10;1.55/10;1.7/10;1.9/10;2.1/10;2.3/10|key=%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Passive:}} Periodically, '''Dr. Mundo''' gains immunity to the next hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect to affect him. Upon resisting one, '''Dr. Mundo''' pays a {{as|health cost}} equal to {{as|4% of his '''current''' health}} and propels a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of the immobilization source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds.
params.description3: '''Dr. Mundo''' can move near the canister to consume it, {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for {{as|4% of his '''maximum''' health}} and reducing the {{sti|cooldown}} of ''Goes Where He Pleases'' by 15 seconds. Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can move near it to destroy it.
params.description4: ''Goes Where He Pleases' '' cooldown resets upon [[respawn|respawning]].
params.static: {{pp|60 to 15 for 6|1;3 to 15 for 5|formula=60 at level 1, then -9 every 3 levels, starting at level 3 and capped at level 15}}
params.notes:
* Upon being triggered by a hostile {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect, ''Goes Where He Pleases'' will also grant '''Dr. Mundo''' immunity to additional immobilizing effects from the same {{tip|cast instance}}.
** Abilities where non-immobilizing effects and damage are nested into immobilizing ones will have them also prevented. Non-immobilizing effects and damage applied separately (the vast majority of cases) are not prevented.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} and {{ai|Black Shield|Morgana}} take priority over ''Goes Where He Pleases''.
* The canister, whether in flight and on the ground, will transition in and out of {{cai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|Death Realm}} alongside ''Dr. Mundo''.{{bug|2}}
* The canister cannot be interacted with while {{tip|untargetable}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Dr. Mundo}} throws an infected bonesaw in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} the first enemy hit.
params.blurb2: If the bonesaw hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}}, '''Dr. Mundo''' {{tip|heals}} for the entire {{as|health cost}}, reduced to half {{as|health cost}} when hitting anything else.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' throws an infected bonesaw in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
params.description2: ''Infected Bonesaw'' has a minimum damage threshold, and is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description3: If the bonesaw hits an enemy, '''Dr. Mundo''' {{tip|heals}} for 50% of the {{as|health cost}}, increased to 100% against {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|monsters}}.
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* {{tip|Spell shield}} blocking the ability's effects on the enemy does not prevent '''Dr. Mundo''' from receiving the health cost refund.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Dr. Mundo}} charges up a defibrillator for a few seconds, continually dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and storing a portion of the post-mitigation damage he takes.
params.blurb2: ''Heart Zapper'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' detonates the defibrillator, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|heal|healing}} for an amount equal to the stored damage, which is increased if at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} is hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' charges up a defibrillator for up to 3 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to nearby enemies and storing {{pplevel|80 to 95|key=%}} of {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], reduced to 25% after the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|5 to 20}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|5*16 to 20*16}}}}
params.description2: ''Heart Zapper'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' detonates the defibrillator, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|heal|healing}} for 50% of [[Health#Grey health|grey health]], increased to 100% if at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} is hit.
params.notes:
* The charge up applies {{tip|persistent area damage}} and the detonation deals {{tip|area damage}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the detonation.
* ''Heart Zapper'' will occasionally deal an additional tick of damage.{{bug}}
* ''Heart Zapper'' and its recast will buffer and cast at the end of {{ais|Infected Bonesaw|Dr. Mundo}} cast time if attempted to cast during it.
** As with all buffering of this type, another input such as a movement command can override the buffering of the spell again.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Dr. Mundo}} gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} based on his {{as|'''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo's''' next basic attack deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}}. If the target dies, their corpse is sent flying away in a line, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies it passes through.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased by {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''Dr. Mundo's missing''' health|0 to 40 for 11|0 to 70|formula=0.57% per missing health %, up to a cap of 70%.|color=health}}. If the target dies or is a small monster, they are sent flying away in a line, though not through terrain, causing all enemies they pass through to take {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} plus ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' minimum '''bonus''' damage.
params.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 45}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4 to 45*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
params.description3: ''Blunt Force Trauma'' as well as the triggering {{as|attack's damage}} is increased to 140% against {{tip|minions}} and 140% against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Minion Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4 to 45*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Minion Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4*1.4 to 45*1.4*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Monster Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4 to 45*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Monster Physical Damage|{{ap|5*1.4*1.4 to 45*1.4*1.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.4*1.4}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
params.description4: ''Blunt Force Trauma {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Dr. Mundo's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' damage is treated as {{tip|basic damage}} but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}, while the target's body being shoved deals {{tip|area damage}} to enemies it passes through.
** The {{tip|basic attack}} is also considered a part of ''Blunt Force Trauma'' and treated as both {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}.<!--or proc damage, PFT-->
* ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' attack works against {{tip|structures}}, consuming the buff and dealing its full damage.
* ''Blunt Force Trauma'' cannot knock back {{tip|wards}}, {{tip|structures}}, epic {{tip|monsters}}, {{cai|I|Illaoi|Tentacles}} and {{cai|W|Yorick}} it kills, nor champions that enter a {{tip|zombie state}} upon dying.
** {{cai|I|Zyra|Plants}} and {{cai|W|Kalista}} can be flung.
* Targets flung away are rendered {{tip|untargetable}} in the process.
* The damage of the enemy's corpse colliding with enemies does not benefit from ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' attack {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Dr. Mundo}} injects himself with chemicals, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''increased''' base health}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, in addition to {{sti|health regeneration|regenerating}} {{as|health}} over the duration.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Dr. Mundo''' injects himself with chemicals to become enhanced for 10 seconds, gaining increased {{sti|health|{{as|'''base''' health}}}}, {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health regeneration}}}}.
params.description2: At rank 3, ''Maximum Dosage's'' increased {{as|'''base''' health}} and {{as|'''bonus''' health regeneration}} are both increased by 5% for each enemy {{tip|champion}} within 1200 units at the time of cast.
params.notes:
* The health regeneration granted by ''Maximum Dosage'' adjusts dynamically to '''Dr. Mundo's''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}}.
* The health regeneration granted by ''Maximum Dosage'' is special cased to be increased by {{ri|Axiom Arcanist}}.
* ''Maximum Dosage'' will end prematurely upon entering {{tip|resurrection}}.
* Against 5 champions, Rank 3 ''Maximum Dosage'' will heal {{as|85% '''Maximum''' health regeneration}} & {{as|50% '''Missing''' Bonus health}}
